Christmas Raw Vegan Chocolate Truffles
By: Justina Elumeze
Published: Saturday, December 24, 2016 - 5:14am

Ingredients




10g cocoa powder
40 ml almond/coconut milk
30g chocolate whey protein
15g almond/peanut butter
10g agave syrup

Preparation

1 Throw all the ingredients together in a bowl or blender. 2 Mix everything together to form a dough like consistency. Roll into individual bite sized balls, then roll in cocoa powder and voila!

About

These home-made truffles are 100% vegan/raw/paleo/gluten-free and totally delicious.
